messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from todays all-hands. procurement wants a concise explanation of the evidence format (not just a blob) and how BYOK avoids any escrow-like flow for EU customers.

 tara (Security): short version: evidence will be structured and verifiable (signed manifests + hash ledger). BYOK = customer keys stay under their control; we use envelope-wrapping so we never hold plain key material. ill add a short blurb for the follow-up.

 jess (Sales): can we get one paragraph that sales can paste into RFPs? they want clear language about "no key escrow" and auditor access windows.

 eric (Compliance): suggested language: "Redwood provides auditor-friendly evidence bundles containing signed manifests, timestamped artifacts, and a tamper-evident hash chain. Auditor access to unredacted artifacts is available via a time-limited approval workflow under executed NDAs. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported via envelope wrapping; raw key material is not stored in plaintext by Redwood."

 nina (Infra): engineering note: for BYOK EU import were exposing an import API that records provenance (uploader, certificate thumbprint, region, and import audit id). well include that provenance in the evidence bundle.

 dev-platform: export/retention options: per-org S3 snapshot, syslog/webhook streaming, and long-term archive with lifecycle rules. retention and archive policy configurable in console/API. sample export manifest: 

```
{
 "bundle_id": "bndl-20260301-01",
 "signed": true,
 "items": ["iam-roster.json","deploy-trail.log","config-snapshot.tar.gz"]
}
```

 jess (Sales): nice. also need to know pricing for long-term retention for procurement.

 eric (Compliance): pricing note: core export (up to X GB/month) included in hosted tiers; extended retention/archive is an add-on. compliance team will draft standard phrasing for contracts.

 tara (Security): auditor access modes: (A) one-off signed bundle export (download URL + manifest), (B) interactive timeboxed session (short-lived role, 1-8 hours) for in-depth reviews. both require compliance approval + logged activity.

 olivia: can we get estimated dates to tell customers?

 tara (Security): targets: signed-manifest evidence pack + provenance ledger: end of June. BYOK EU import beta: September. timeboxed auditor access + retention UI: July. these are subject to change; will mark them tentative in the follow-up.

 compliance-bot: @jess created COMP-1001: "RFP one-pager + evidence language + BYOK FAQ" assigned to @jess and @eric, due 2026-05-14.

 jess (Sales): will draft the RFP paragraph and the FAQ; will ask solutions-eng to vet wording.

 olivia: thanks everyone. tara/eric please paste the short bullets into the all-hands follow-up doc and ill include in the customer note.

 tara (Security): will post a 5-bullet summary in ~45 minutes and tag leadership.
